looks.label: Mars 2427 review (49 samples, 29.0 px), x 1200..1920 y 600..1080 at 1 to 1: box, ends 0.5 (scratch). The painted strokes become land in motion, cliffs and ridges keep their shape
Flight 2757 review, the white patch x 690..930 y 290..500 at 3 times: box, ends 0.5 (scratch). The fine lines along the way stay, their blunt ends taper

Flight after Mars, frame 2757 review (79 samples, 47.3 px), x 300..1020 y 60..560 at 1 to 1: box shutter (as it is), and ends 0.5 in the flight (scratch, the ends as built do not reach a flight). No separate copies in either; with the ends the streaks taper and the white patch is more compact

Uranus 4130 review (26 samples, 15.4 px), the storm x 1040..1280 y 580..760 at 2 times: box, ends 0.5, ends 0.5 with cover 2 (scratch). The blocky white specks stand in all three: they are the cloud picture's own grain, neither the ends nor the cover moves them
Mercury 730 review, x 0..360 y 60..330 at 2 times: box, ends 0.5 (scratch). The bars with fine lines inside become ovals
Mercury 730 review (53 samples, 31.7 px), x 0..720 y 0..480 at 1 to 1: box shutter, and the shutter's ends at 0.5 (scratch). The rows of bars become tapered streaks, the craters keep their shape
Uranus 4130 review (15.4 px, 26 samples), the clouds at the limb x 1240..1480 y 150..310 at 3 times: box, ends 0.5 (scratch): the smear is shorter, the puffs keep their shape
